notes: PHASE-000 foundation is complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress. The verified Windows audio implementation now includes the Rust audio contracts and bounded queues, device catalog/reselection, bounded stream recovery, IAudioClient3 shared-mode period planning, SharedCapturePlan cadence, event-driven WASAPI IAudioCaptureClient capture, native sample decoding, packet reframing and AudioFrame assembly, an event-driven CapturePump with bounded queue draining, structured recoverable WASAPI device/resource/audio-service lifecycle failures, and CaptureRuntime with externally scheduled bounded reopen recovery and sequence continuity. IMMNotificationClient registration now runs on a dedicated Windows MTA thread and feeds a bounded non-blocking notification queue with dropped-event accounting; Windows CI verifies registration/unregistration. The owner-thread notification bridge filters active capture-route changes and collapses a relevant notification batch to at most one recovery transition. The latest exact implementation head c5d2984d587a344b36ae1ae753af8e26500b7e78 passed Ubuntu repository-integrity run 34509104650 and Windows Audio Validation run 34509104681. This is code-level/runtime-smoke evidence only: physical unplug/replug or communications-default change firing and recovery on controlled audio hardware, hardware CPU/latency/jitter/deadline evidence, the production virtual microphone endpoint/driver, processed and bypass audio reaching approved calling applications, and driver signing/install/update/uninstall/rollback remain pending. README and docs/architecture/WINDOWS-AUDIO-IMPLEMENTATION.md are reconciled to this boundary. WU-002 and MOD-002 are not complete until those required routing, compatibility and performance boundaries are verified. Paid provider usage, proprietary model training, production credentials/cloud spend and production deployment remain subject to applicable provider/data/compute/release gates.
